reuse.why: Changes only the two existing shared worst-case helpers in shared/schedules.ts (and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold), which every consumer already routes through.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is rewritten in place in getRangeWorstCase and getApproxWorstCase.

placement.why: The rule stays in the shared schedules module where the tree defines it; no caller is touched.

scope.why: Two one-line helper changes, the matching test updates and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - threshold express 'lowest value allowed' directly and are trivially owned.
